title: Great God! My Joyful Thanks to Thee
description: Great God! My Joyful Thanks to Thee in Tonic Solfa to UXBRIDGE, doh is E: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: Simon Browne wrote these words. They were printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 444 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “"Giving thanks to God in all things."”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Long Metre (8.8.8.8), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to UXBRIDGE; any other Long Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Great God! my joy-ful thanks to thee Shall, like thy gifts, con-tin-ual be: In con-stant streams thy boun-ty flows, Nor end nor in-ter-mis-sion knows.

lines: Great God! my joyful thanks to thee
Shall, like thy gifts, continual be:
In constant streams thy bounty flows,
Thy kindness all my comforts gives;
My numerous wants thy hand relieves;
Nor can I ever, Lord, be poor,
Who live on thy exhaustless store.
If what I wish thy will denies,
It is that thou art good and wise;
Afflictions, which may make me mourn,
Thou canst, thou dost, to blessings turn.
Deep, Lord, upon my thankful breast,
Let all thy favors be imprest;
And though withdrawn thy gifts should be
In all things I'll give thanks to thee.

licence: Public domain: Simon Browne died in 1732.
credits: Words by Simon Browne (1680–1732), public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to UXBRIDGE by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
